title: Lupanov circuit construction
statement: For each natural number $n$, Boolean function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$, and natural number $k \le n$, the Lupanov construction assigns a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices. Its gates are ordered so that each gate reads only input vertices or earlier gates, and its output is a vertex of the circuit.
caveat: The snippet does not include the definition of the gate-list construction, so its specific gates and output cannot be described further.
